name: Direct Voxel Rasterization with Edge Fading
definition: Renders 3D spheres into a voxel grid by iterating over axis-aligned bounding boxes, computing Euclidean distance to the sphere center, applying a linear edge fade, and blending colors using maximum blending.
summary: Direct Voxel Rasterization with Edge Fading renders 3D spheres into a voxel grid using maximum blending and linear intensity falloff to create anti-aliased edges, offering a lightweight, real-time alternative to ray-marching volume rendering.
